title: SEC4: PinnedCertVerifier signature methods need why-comment
description: In xcid_client.rs, PinnedCertVerifier implements verify_tls12_signature and verify_tls13_signature by delegating to the default rustls crypto provider. There is no comment explaining why these methods do not simply return Ok(HandshakeSignatureValid::assertion()). A reader familiar with TLS certificate pinning might expect that since the cert fingerprint is checked in verify_server_cert, the handshake signature methods could be no-ops. The reason they must still validate is that the handshake transcript signature proves the server holds the private key matching the pinned certificate; without it, a MITM could replay the pinned cert. A one-line comment at each method stating this rationale would prevent readers from incorrectly simplifying the implementation.
